fields.Description: airtable-sync.mjs's push() only compared the 'Last Refreshed' field to detect conflicts. A direct edit in the Airtable UI to any other field (Notes, Company, Lane, etc.) never bumped that field, so push() saw 'unchanged' and silently overwrote the real edit with stale local data.
fields.Title: r12 — Airtable two-way sync last-write-wins on Last Refreshed
fields.Notes: Fixed by snapshotting all pushable fields at pull time (snapshotFields) and diffing the full set on push (diffSnapshot), instead of comparing only Last Refreshed. Backward-compatible fallback for old-shape sync-state files. Regression test added in test/airtable-sync.test.mjs.

fields.Description: 06-09's file is object-keyed with no columnId/createdAt; 06-10's is array-of-objects with columnId/createdAt. 13 cards (4 + 9) are pending import and the single import path may not handle both shapes.
fields.Title: B10 — kanban-import-{date}.json schema diverged 06-09 vs 06-10
fields.Notes: RESOLVED 2026-07-22 -- root cause was in auto-submit.mjs's extractEligibleCardsFromJson(): it hard-rejected (threw on) the 06-10-style array-of-cards shape entirely, only accepting the 06-09-style object-keyed PulseJob shape. Also found the two shapes differ in per-card field names, not just wrapping (06-09 uses K2 PulseJob fields like title/state; 06-10's array is already in auto-submit's native card shape with role/columnId) -- a naive 'just unwrap the array' fix would have blanked roles and reset columnId to its default. Fixed to detect and correctly handle both without translation errors. Verified against the real 06-09 and 06-10 files: 06-09 -> 4 eligible cards correctly parsed (unchanged); 06-10 -> no longer throws, correctly evaluates each card. All 71 tests across test/auto-submit-live.test.mjs + test/auto-submit.test.mjs pass. Uncommitted. Note: kanban-inject.mjs's separate buildSeenUrls() dedup-set builder has a related but distinct gap (reads the wrong nesting level for both shapes, contributing 0 URLs from kanban-import-*.json to the seen-set) -- not fixed here since it's a different function/consumer, flagged for a follow-up look.

fields.Source: Discovered during 2026-07-22 test-suite run (test/auto-submit-live.test.mjs 'extractEligibleCards' suite was failing 2 of 5)
fields.Description: isEligible() in scripts/auto-submit.mjs allowed grade C cards (weak keyword match) into live-submission eligibility, contradicting (1) its own pre-existing regression test, which explicitly expects only A/B, and (2) generate-cl.mjs's eligibleFromBoard(), which only auto-generates cover letters for A/B cards. Net effect: a grade-C 'weak fit' posting could get auto-submitted to without ever getting a matching cover letter -- exactly what the readiness/CL quality gate exists to prevent.
fields.Title: auto-submit.mjs isEligible() let grade-C cards through to live-submission eligibility
fields.Notes: Fixed: isEligible() now requires grade A or B (matching every other gate in the codebase). All 55 tests in test/auto-submit-live.test.mjs now pass (was 53/55). Flagging as high priority since it's a real business-risk fix to submission-selection logic, not routine cleanup -- worth a quick look before the next batch commit. Uncommitted.

fields.Description: The Archive table is missing fields present on Active Pipeline (Card ID, Lane, URL, etc.), so archived rows land blank and a warning fires on every archive-stale run.
fields.Title: B-12 — Airtable Archive table schema missing Active-Pipeline fields
fields.Notes: Escalated 2026-07-22 -- investigated: Archive table (tblxzlwcG0hVwvo17) has 9 fields (Tracker #, Date, Company, Role, Grade, Status, Referral Sent, CL Sent, Notes) mirroring the old applications.md layout. Active Pipeline (tbldVU2pHhQjOHjzh) has 8 fields Archive lacks: Card ID, Lane, Platform, URL, Job Description, Keywords, Connection Name, Connection LinkedIn, Has Connection, Warm Referral, Created At, Last Refreshed, Connection Count, Connection Options. archive-stale.mjs already handles this gracefully by design (matches fields by name, leaves unmatched ones blank, logs a warning instead of failing) -- so this is a data-completeness gap, not a broken pipeline. Didn't add the fields myself: this changes your live tracking base and is a real schema decision (do you want full Job Description text + Keywords duplicated onto every archived row forever, or just enough fields to stop the warning, e.g. Card ID/Platform/URL?) rather than a mechanical fix. Two options: (1) add all missing fields to mirror Active Pipeline fully, or (2) add a few key ones and accept the rest as an intentional gap. Your call.

fields.Description: dedup-tracker.mjs won't dedupe 'Software Engineer' vs 'Software Engineering' — both reduce to the same token after stop-word removal, but the Math.min(2, smaller) overlap floor blocks single-word matches.

fields.Description: Generated cover letter for a Coupa posting was missing the company name and scored 0% keyword match, so the quality gate correctly held it back — but it means a real application didn't go out.
fields.Title: Coupa job cover-letter quality gate held back a real application
fields.Notes: ROOT CAUSE FOUND 2026-07-22: not a generation-logic bug (company-name lookup was fine) -- readiness-scorer.mjs's findClFileForCard() picked up a STALE, CORRUPTED file from output/ (a past write/sync failure had stripped every letter out of it, leaving ~80 bytes of stray punctuation), and silently scored that garbage as a real cover letter: 0% keywords + no company name, exactly as logged. Broader finding: ~150 of 308 files in output/ show this same letter-stripped corruption -- see new card 'output/ cover-letter files: ~150 of 308 silently corrupted'. Fix applied: findClFileForCard() now runs an isCorruptedCl() sanity check (min length + letter-density) and skips corrupted candidates, falling through to 'no cover letter found' so a fresh one gets regenerated instead of a garbled one being silently scored. Verified: a Coupa-shaped test card now correctly reports score_skipped/'no cover letter found' instead of a bogus 0% score; all 26 tests in test/readiness-scorer.test.mjs still pass. Uncommitted.
